**M1 [statement-contradiction] R1, R2; §4.4/§4.5; AC1, AC13 — preview feasibility is unenforced.** Config validation checks only `max_metadata_envelope_bytes < delivery_ceiling_bytes`, yet R1/AC1 bound the preview by `preview_ceiling_bytes` while §4.2/AC13 also require a non-empty content prefix; a loadable config (preview ceiling below the preview metadata: JSON keys + 43-byte handle + `total_bytes` digits + `upstream_code` up to 513 bytes) makes both impossible, and only pages have a typed fallback (`internal_error`). The envelope is called a constant but its digit widths are "derived from `max_retained_result_bytes`", which cannot bound a preview's `total_bytes` (it reports an unretained, unbounded result), and the enumerated fields omit preview-only `paging_required`/`retained`/`retention`/`retention_reason`. Observable consequence: an admissible configuration yields previews that violate R1/AC1/AC13 with no defined failure. The spec must state a fixed worst-case envelope including preview-only fields and unbounded `total_bytes` width, a validation `envelope + 1 ≤ preview_ceiling_bytes`, the typed fallback, and which task owns the definition (T1 currently validates an invariant whose inputs are T2's keys).

**M2 [statement-contradiction] R10; §4.2/§4.6; AC16 — the unretainable branch cannot keep the promise.** §4.2 truncates `upstream_code` to `max_upstream_code_bytes` + marker, but R10/§4.6 require the full code "byte-exact in the retained result" on every branch and AC16 requires the preview to keep "its own `upstream_code`". On the unretainable branch no retained result exists. Observable consequence: for an error whose code exceeds the bound, AC16 fails if the code is whole and the preview bound fails if it is not; the full code becomes unrecoverable after the preview. R10/§4.6 must be scoped to the retainable branch and the unretainable observable stated.

**L1 [ac-not-falsifiable] R6; §4.3; AC6 —** the description half names no required observable, so a description containing no paging fields still passes `TestRetrieveResultSchema`; name the tokens/contract the description must carry.

T2's "purge across all four seams" test is vacuous or unsatisfiable; the real invariant is epoch-keyed namespaces plus purge on reaper/DELETE/SDK-session-loss. Also §4.5's "retired owner → `invalid_handle`" is not the observable when the caller still presents the retired epoch (exposure admission rejects before the handler); state both observables.
